text:
maria_pm: Quick heads-up — two recent asks look like they're asking for the same capability but with slightly different surface areas. ACME wants per-tenant realtime usage + alerts (TCK-789). BetaCorp asked for a tenant usage dashboard + export (TCK-802). Can we consolidate so we don't duplicate work?

josh_support: Yep, support triaged both as customer-driven P2s. Both customers noted renewals next quarter, so sales is watching. Details: ACME needs alerting thresholds, BetaCorp emphasized CSV export for finance.

ankit_sales: FWIW from sales: both deals are mid-stage. If we can show a roadmap/ETA it materially helps renewal conversations. Can we add a "renewal_impact" tag?

sophia_eng: From an engineering perspective this is two problem areas: 1) metrics/ingest + realtime aggregation, 2) frontend dashboard + export. I'd prefer a single epic with two child stories rather than separate, duplicate tickets.

maria_pm: Proposal: create epic R-INF-234 "tenant usage observability" with child tasks: R-INF-234a infra (metrics + alerting), R-INF-234b UI (dashboard + export). Preliminary priority: infra 5/10 effort, UI 6/10 effort. Score by customer impact + ACV. Thoughts?

eva_se: +1 on grouping. BetaCorp mockups attached in drive (link). For ACME, I have sample alert threshold requests — can paste into the ticket. Grouping will help us reuse metrics pipeline.

josh_support: I'll prepare the canned customer update once the epic exists. Suggested comms: "We're consolidating your requests into a single workstream to speed delivery; will share scope and ETA after scoping."

ankit_sales: Assign me as stakeholder for comms and renewal coordination. Also please add label: "renewal_impact=yes". If we can get any ETA even rough that helps.

sophia_eng: If you want a quick spike I can do a 3d spike to validate ingestion and KV design. Estimate full work: infra 2w, UI 1w. If we split, infra needs priority first.

maria_pm: Sounds good. I'll create epic + subtasks and include these estimates and labels. Owners: sophia_eng (infra), eva_se (UI prototyping). I'll add prioritization notes: customer-driven, renewal_impact, effort estimates, and a 3-day spike flag. Will update by EOD.

triage-bot: Created epic <https://tracker/r/INF-234|R-INF-234> and subtasks <https://tracker/r/INF-234a|R-INF-234a> <https://tracker/r/INF-234b|R-INF-234b>. Fields: priority=P2, labels=[customer-driven, renewal_impact], estimate=infra:2w ui:1w, spike=3d.

luke_pmm: Suggest including a short customer-facing release note template and internal launch checklist (docs, API changes, pricing notes). Happy to draft release blurb.

maria_pm: added PM checklist item for release note + internal docs. @ankit_sales you'll get a copy to share with customers once scope approved.

josh_support: Thanks — I'll hold off on comms until you push the ticket update, then I'll send the consolidated note to both customers.

ankit_sales: Thanks team. tagging @maria_pm for follow-up next steps: create epic, add labels, set owner, and draft ETA. :thumbsup:

maria_pm: Will do. Final action items in the epic: 1) scope spike (3d) 2) infra task + estimate 3) UI task + mock + export option 4) comms template for ACME/BetaCorp. I'll update thread when tickets are fleshed out. :white_check_mark:
